evals.prompt:
Audit my Meta ads account. Here's the data:

```json
{"account": {"name": "Harborline Skincare", "currency": "USD", "attribution": "7d_click_1d_view"},
"pixel": {"pixel_id": "556677", "capi_enabled": true, "dedup_enabled": false, "emq_score": 4.8, "last_event_at": "2 hours ago"},
"campaigns": [{"name": "ASC - Sales", "objective": "OUTCOME_SALES", "special_ad_category": "NONE", "spend_30d": 12000, "purchases": 200, "purchase_value": 36000, "roas": 3.0, "cpm": 19, "link_ctr": 1.3, "frequency_7d": 4.1, "cpm_trend_wow": "+31%", "link_ctr_trend_wow": "-30%"}, {"name": "Prospecting - Interests", "objective": "OUTCOME_SALES", "special_ad_category": "NONE", "spend_30d": 5000, "purchases": 40, "purchase_value": 6000, "roas": 1.2, "cpm": 21, "link_ctr": 0.9, "frequency_7d": 2.0}],
"adsets": [{"campaign": "Prospecting - Interests", "name": "Activewear Lookalike", "audience_overlap_with_sibling": 0.62, "placements": "manual: feed only"}, {"campaign": "Prospecting - Interests", "name": "Skincare Lookalike", "audience_overlap_with_sibling": 0.62}]}
```
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit (no mutations) that leads with the verdict and top 3 actions. Pixel + CAPI is the upstream STOP-condition input: EMQ 4.8 with dedup off must be flagged Critical (per the Pixel + Tracking matrix, CAPI-on/dedup-off at EMQ < 5 is Critical) and the audit should recommend fixing tracking before scaling decisions because everything downstream is unreliable. It should diagnose 'ASC - Sales' as creative fatigue (frequency 4.1, CPM +31%, link CTR -30% w/w) and recommend creative refresh, not budget cuts. It should flag the 62% audience overlap between the two sibling lookalike ad sets and recommend consolidation rather than bid caps. Manual feed-only placements should be questioned versus Advantage+ Placements. Every reported ROAS must footnote the modeled-conversion premium (20-40% overstatement) and cite the 7DC1DV window. It should persist business-context.json and personas and end with a handoff to /meta-ads.
expectations: Treats Pixel + CAPI as the upstream STOP condition: flags EMQ 4.8 with dedup off as Critical and recommends fixing tracking before scaling decisions
Diagnoses 'ASC - Sales' as creative fatigue (frequency > 3.0 with CPM rising and link CTR falling w/w) and recommends creative refresh, not budget cuts
Flags 62% audience overlap between the two sibling lookalike ad sets and recommends consolidation rather than bid caps
Questions the manual feed-only placements versus Advantage+ Placements absent supporting data
Footnotes every Meta-reported ROAS with the modeled-conversion premium (typically 20-40% overstatement) and cites the 7DC1DV attribution window
Stays read-only — recommends fixes via /meta-ads rather than mutating the account
Names specific campaigns, ad sets, and dollar amounts; persists business-context.json and personas and ends with a handoff to /meta-ads

evals.prompt:
Can you audit my Facebook ads? Here's what I've got:

```json
{"account": {"name": "Lighthouse Coffee Co", "currency": "USD"},
"pixel": {"pixel_id": "998877", "capi_enabled": false, "emq_score": 3.1, "last_event_at": "5 days ago"},
"campaigns": [{"name": "Always-On Sales", "objective": "OUTCOME_SALES", "spend_30d": 7000, "purchases": 110, "purchase_value": 19800, "roas": 2.83, "cpm": 16, "link_ctr": 1.1, "frequency_7d": 2.4}]}
```
evals.expected_output: The audit must immediately treat tracking as the #1 critical issue: CAPI is off and EMQ is 3.1 (CAPI-off at EMQ < 5 is Critical per the matrix), and Smart Bidding is starved regardless of creative quality. This is the STOP condition — recommend pausing scaling decisions until pixel + CAPI are fixed before recommending anything else. The reported ROAS of 2.83x cannot be trusted as ground truth; the audit must footnote the modeled-conversion premium and note that with weak event matching the reported number is especially unreliable. It should not recommend budget or creative changes ahead of fixing tracking, and it should still persist business-context.json and personas before handing off to /meta-ads.
expectations: Flags missing CAPI and EMQ 3.1 as the #1 critical issue and applies the STOP condition (pause scaling decisions until tracking is fixed)
Explains that with broken/weak event matching, Smart Bidding is starved and reported ROAS cannot be trusted as ground truth
Footnotes the reported 2.83x ROAS with the modeled-conversion premium and the weak-event-match caveat
Does not recommend budget or creative optimizations ahead of fixing pixel + CAPI
Stays read-only and routes the fix through /meta-ads
Still persists business-context.json and personas even though the report is short
